risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, reporting earnings, loan growth, capital status, stock performance, and credit-quality metrics. Risk factors include increased criticized assets and loan-loss provisions, agricultural portfolio exposure, nonperforming and restructured loans, regulatory costs, and an unfavorable interest-rate environment. Management maintains a cautiously positive outlook, but relies on forward-looking assumptions regarding loan growth, net interest yield, asset quality, and regulatory impacts.
